---
title: "Join the People directory"
title-block-banner: true
---

Fill in this application form to appear on the [People](index.qmd) page. A MIDSEA
maintainer will review your application before it goes live. To change your
details later, submit the form again with the same email address.

```{=html}
<!--
  ENDPOINT is the Apps Script web app URL (Deploy -> Manage deployments in
  the Sheet's Apps Script). See scripts/apps-script/Code.gs.
-->
<form id="apply-form" class="apply-form" novalidate
      data-endpoint="https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbxT_4MRYiYcGV6kESLZlBna5pAhV0_rKjHWTRTPWFGJmLfNIB2soac85R5-U8E-FC4VFw/exec">
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="apply-name" class="form-label">Full name *</label>
    <input id="apply-name" name="name" class="form-control" required maxlength="200" autocomplete="name">
  </div>
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="apply-email" class="form-label">Email *</label>
    <input id="apply-email" name="email" type="email" class="form-control" required maxlength="200" autocomplete="email">
    <div class="form-text"><b>Not shown on the website</b>. We use it to contact you and to find your
      <a href="https://gravatar.com">Gravatar</a> if you do not upload a photo.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="apply-title" class="form-label">Job title</label>
    <input id="apply-title" name="title" class="form-control" maxlength="200" autocomplete="organization-title">
  </div>
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="apply-institution" class="form-label">Institution</label>
    <input id="apply-institution" name="institution" class="form-control" maxlength="200" autocomplete="organization">
  </div>
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="apply-url" class="form-label">Profile page link</label>
    <input id="apply-url" name="profile_url" type="url" class="form-control" maxlength="200" placeholder="https://">
  </div>
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="apply-photo" class="form-label">Profile photo</label>
    <input id="apply-photo" name="photo" type="file" class="form-control" accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp">
    <div class="form-text">JPEG, PNG, or WebP. A square photo looks best.</div>
  </div>
  <!-- Honeypot: hidden from people, bots fill it in. -->
  <div class="apply-hp" aria-hidden="true">
    <label for="apply-website">Website</label>
    <input id="apply-website" name="website" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off">
  </div>
  <div class="mb-3 form-check">
    <input id="apply-consent" name="consent" type="checkbox" class="form-check-input" required>
    <label for="apply-consent" class="form-check-label">I agree that my name, job title,
      institution, profile link, and photo appear on the public People page. *</label>
  </div>
  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Submit application</button>
  <div id="apply-status" class="mt-3" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
</form>

<script>
(() => {
  const form = document.getElementById("apply-form");
  const status = document.getElementById("apply-status");
  const button = form.querySelector("button[type=submit]");
  // Keep in step with CONFIG.maxPhotoB64 in Code.gs (and GitHub's 64 KB
  // dispatch limit): the photo travels to GitHub inside that payload.
  const MAX_PHOTO_B64 = 45000;
  const PHOTO_STEPS = [[400, 0.85], [400, 0.7], [320, 0.7], [240, 0.7]];

  function show(msg, kind) {
    status.className = `mt-3 alert alert-${kind}`;
    status.textContent = msg;
  }

  // Resize in the browser: Apps Script cannot resize images.
  async function resizePhoto(file) {
    let bitmap;
    try {
      bitmap = await createImageBitmap(file);
    } catch {
      throw new Error("This browser cannot read that photo. Please use a JPEG or PNG file.");
    }
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    for (const [size, quality] of PHOTO_STEPS) {
      const scale = Math.min(1, size / Math.max(bitmap.width, bitmap.height));
      canvas.width = Math.round(bitmap.width * scale);
      canvas.height = Math.round(bitmap.height * scale);
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fff"; // JPEG has no transparency
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      ctx.drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      const b64 = canvas.toDataURL("image/jpeg", quality).split(",")[1];
      if (b64.length <= MAX_PHOTO_B64) return b64;
    }
    throw new Error("The photo is too detailed to shrink. Please choose another photo.");
  }

  form.addEventListener("submit", async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!form.checkValidity()) {
      form.classList.add("was-validated");
      show("Please fill in the fields marked *, and check the email and link.", "warning");
      return;
    }
    button.disabled = true;
    show("Sending…", "info");
    try {
      const f = form.elements;
      const data = {
        name: f.name.value,
        email: f.email.value,
        title: f.title.value,
        institution: f.institution.value,
        profile_url: f.profile_url.value,
        consent: f.consent.checked,
        website: f.website.value,
      };
      if (f.photo.files.length) data.photo_b64 = await resizePhoto(f.photo.files[0]);
      // No Content-Type header: a text/plain POST skips the CORS preflight,
      // which Apps Script web apps do not answer.
      const res = await fetch(form.dataset.endpoint, { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(data) });
      const out = await res.json();
      if (!out.ok) throw new Error(out.error || "The server rejected the application.");
      form.reset();
      form.classList.remove("was-validated");
      show("Thank you. We received your application. It appears on the People page after review.", "success");
    } catch (err) {
      show(`${err.message} If this keeps happening, please use the Contact page.`, "danger");
    } finally {
      button.disabled = false;
    }
  });
})();
</script>
```
